title: Coefficient tower equation for rational pullback
statement: Fix a prime l and finite extensions E,L,M of Q_l, with Q_l-algebra maps ι:E→L and j:L→M. Let f:X→Y be a morphism of schemes with l invertible in all residue fields. For every K in the intrinsic rational constructible category over E on Y, the prescribed rational pullback/scalar comparison of [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations] satisfies the coefficient-tower square: extend its E→L component to M, compose with its L→M component at the extended K, and then with rational pullback of the scalar associator on Y; the result equals the scalar associator on X at the pulled-back K followed by its E→M component for j∘ι. Both associators are precisely sfRationalScalarComp of [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition]. The displayed Lean equation retains all associators and uses no algebraically closed field or quotient of stagewise morphisms.

source.place: scalarOperationsOrdinary_tower, pullback clause; completion conjugation and rationalization as in the common-stage paragraph of def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom

proof.text: Apply the pullback clause of scalarOperationsOrdinary_tower to E→L→M on the underlying integral object. This supplies an equality of actual ordinary derived morphisms, with the prescribed ordinary scalar associators.

By the uniqueness clause of sfIntegralOrdinaryComparison_existsUnique, its comparison is the restriction of scalarCompletionIso. Expand sfIntegralScalarComp through its component specification and integralPullbackScalarComparison through scalarPullbackCompleted. The private conjugate_tower calculation moves the scalarCompletion natural transformation across the first completed comparison, uses naturality of the second ordinary pullback comparison, and cancels the inverse completion factors. Its remaining equation is exactly the ordinary tower equation from Step 1. Full-subcategory hom_ext gives the integral constructible tower equation.

Apply sfRationalConstructibleLocalization to the integral tower equality. The component specifications of rationalPullbackScalarComparison and sfRationalScalarComp identify their components with these localized integral maps. The scalar and pullback pure-tensor specifications at coefficient one identify both mapped components, and their object specifications identify every endpoint. Compose the resulting heterogeneous equalities using the private map_heq, app_heq and comp_heq lemmas. Functor.map_comp and eq_of_heq give the asserted rational equality for every object.

proof_origin.place: E1: private conjugate_tower and integral_tower; rationalPullbackScalarComparison_tower transports the integral equation through the existing component specifications. Original source: scalarOperationsOrdinary_tower, pullback clause.

lean.statement:
theorem rationalPullbackScalarComparison_tower
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E L M : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    [Field M] [Algebra ℚ_[l] M] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] M]
    (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L) (j : L →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] M)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (K : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E Y) :
    (sfRationalScalarExtension l L X 0 (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) M j).map
        ((rationalPullbackScalarComparison l E L ι f).hom.app K) ≫
      (rationalPullbackScalarComparison l L M j f).hom.app
        ((sfRationalScalarExtension l E Y 0
          (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) L ι).obj K) ≫
      (rationalDerivedPullback l M f).map
        ((sfRationalScalarComp l E L ι Y 0
          (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) M j).hom.app K) =
    (sfRationalScalarComp l E L ι X 0
        (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) M j).hom.app
        ((rationalDerivedPullback l E f).obj K) ≫
      (rationalPullbackScalarComparison l E M (j.comp ι) f).hom.app K
